credits.title: Photo, illustration and font credits
credits.lead: Every photo here was taken by someone, somewhere real. This page names them, says where, and links the licence that lets us show their work.
credits.adaptations: We crop and resize photos and remove their location data. A cropped photo under a CC BY-SA licence is an adaptation, shared under the same licence.
credits.illustrationsNote: Our decorative drawings are AI illustrations; <link>see how each one was made</link>.

illustrations.title: AI illustrations
illustrations.lead: We made these drawings with AI image and video models, used through ElevenLabs (each card names them), to fill the site with life until our commissioned illustrations arrive. Each one was checked against our art rubric and carries an “AI illustration” label wherever it means something. They never stand in for a child’s entry, and no photo on this site is AI.
illustrations.rules: Our art rubric scores each drawing on meaning, style, craft, Indian authenticity, composition, legibility, delight and clean edges. It turns down any drawing with children, people or hands; feeding by hand, milk, bread or sweets; cages, leashes or nose ropes; a distressed animal; or text or logos.
